title: COBA: Counterbias Text Augmentation for Mitigating Various Spurious Correlations via Semantic Triples

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Human-CAD test set and out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks (e.g., testing models trained on IMDB on SST-2 and Yelp) to assess whether models inappropriately rely on non-causal, irrelevant textual patterns instead of genuine semantic relationships.

Quantified using three benchmark datasets: StereoSet (SS), CrowS-Pairs, and WikiBias. The evaluation tests the effectiveness of replacing gender-related words with words of a different gender during the semantic triple-level data augmentation.

Evaluated in a preliminary experiment by measuring downstream classification accuracy on the Measuring Hate Speech Corpus, which contains racially biased language, to assess the framework's broader bias mitigation capabilities.
